title: Proportional Relationships
preview: Unit rates, proportional relationships in tables, graphs, and equations, and applications to real-world problems.
description: Indiana standards 7.RP.1, 7.RP.3. Students identify the constant of proportionality across representations and write equations y = mx to model proportional situations.

sections.label: 1-1 Unit Rates Involving Ratios and Fractions
sections.description: Identify the unit rate (constant of proportionality) in tables, graphs, equations, and verbal descriptions.

sections.label: 1-2 Understand Proportional Relationships
sections.description: Recognise proportional relationships and articulate what makes them proportional.

sections.label: 1-3 Tables of Proportional Relationships
sections.description: Identify proportional relationships from a table by checking for a constant ratio.

sections.label: 1-4 Graphs of Proportional Relationships
sections.description: Identify proportional graphs as straight lines through the origin.

sections.label: 1-5 Equations of Proportional Relationships
sections.description: Write y = mx from a context, table, or graph.

sections.label: 1-6 Solve Problems Involving Proportional Relationships
sections.description: Apply proportional reasoning to multi-step real-world problems.

source.name: Plug N Play
